neighbours.label: the object or particle completing a phrasal or reflexive verb construction (help themselves, cozy up, help himself)
fire: The visitors did not help themselves by arriving two hours late.
Critics accused the senator of cozying up to big oil companies.
He never quite helps himself when he argues with the referee.
The guests were told to help themselves to the buffet.
She has been sucking up to the new manager all week.
The young players need to learn to help themselves out of trouble.
The minister was criticised for buddying up to wealthy donors.
If the team keeps making mistakes, they will not help themselves in the standings.
quiet: The visitors did not help the hosts by arriving two hours late.
Critics accused the senator of taking money from big oil companies.
He never quite helps the team when he argues with the referee.
The guests were told to wait for the buffet.
She has been working with the new manager all week.
The young players need to learn to stay out of trouble.
The minister was criticised for dining with wealthy donors.
If the team keeps making mistakes, they will drop in the standings.
